Dream Team event has begun!<br>\r\n<h2 class=\"heading\">\u00a0Event Availability Period<\/h2>\r\n\u00a010:00 p.m., Sep 27\u20139:59 p.m., Oct 4, 2026 (UTC)<br>\r\n<h2 class=\"heading\">\u00a0Reward Collection Period<\/h2>\r\n\u00a010:00 p.m., Oct 4\u20139:59 p.m., Oct 7, 2026 (UTC)<br>\r\n<h2 class=\"heading\">\u00a0Event Overview<\/h2>\r\n\u00a0In Aim for the Stars! Dream Team events, your goal is to build the ultimate team of seven racers, including one of your own Veteran Umamusume and an additional six Umamusume scouted over the course of the event.<br>\r\n\u00a0Do your best to defeat the teams of other trainers from around the world, and for each matchup you win, you'll have the opportunity to scout a racer from the opposing team!<br>\r\n<h2 class=\"heading\">\u00a0Building a Team<\/h2>\r\n\u00a0The team you will use to enter Scout Races consists of seven racers: one captain and six regular members.<br>\r\n\u00a0The captain can be selected freely from your own Veteran Umamusume.<br>\r\n\u00a0The regular members can be replaced when you are given the opportunity to scout racers during the event.<br>\r\n<h2 class=\"heading\">\u00a0Scout Races<\/h2>\r\n\u00a0You can enter Scout Races using the team you have built.<br>\r\n\u00a0In each Scout Race, you will face the team of another trainer from around the world.<br>\r\n\u00a0All seven members of your team will face all seven members of the opponent's team in the same race.<br>\r\n\u00a0Based on the results of the race, you can earn rewards and Scout Points.<br>\r\n<h2 class=\"heading\">\u00a0Scout Race Tickets<\/h2>\r\n\u00a0Each Scout Race costs one Scout Race Ticket to enter.<br>\r\n\u00a0Your Scout Race Tickets will replenish up to a maximum of five at 10:00 p.m. (UTC) on each day of the event.<br>\r\n\u00a0You can also obtain Scout Race Tickets from the event's daily missions, and up to five additional tickets can be replenished each day by using carats, Carrot Jelly items, or Carrot Jelly Mini items.<br>\r\n\u00a0(You can only replenish Scout Race Tickets using carats or items after consuming all Scout Race Tickets you currently possess.)<br>\r\n<h2 class=\"heading\">\u00a0Race Conditions<\/h2>\r\n\u00a0Racecourse: Tokyo, Nakayama, Kyoto, Morioka<br>\r\n\u00a0Season: Fall<br>\r\n\u00a0Race conditions other than the season are variable and change every three races entered.<br>\r\n<h2 class=\"heading\">\u00a0Scout Time<\/h2>\r\n\u00a0Winning a Scout Race triggers a Scout Time opportunity.<br>\r\n\u00a0During Scout Time, you can consume Scout Points to replace one of your current team members with a racer from the team of the opponent you just faced.<br>\r\n<h2 class=\"heading\">\u00a0Team History<\/h2>\r\n<h3 class=\"subheading\">\u00a0Umamusume Records<\/h3>\r\n\u00a0Each time you win a Scout Race, all racers in the winning team will be added to your Umamusume Records roster.<br>\r\n\u00a0Each racer in your Umamusume Records grants a bonus to all of your team members' attributes in subsequent Scout Races.<br>\r\n<h3 class=\"subheading\">\u00a0Scout Point Bonus<\/h3>\r\n\u00a0When you earn Scout Points, a bonus will be applied based on the number of racers in your Umamusume Records.<br>\r\n<h3 class=\"subheading\">\u00a0Team Skills<\/h3>\r\n\u00a0You can earn team skills by winning Scout Races with certain specific combinations of racers in your team.<br>\r\n\u00a0Once obtained, team skills can be used by all of your team members during Scout Races.<br>\r\n<h2 class=\"heading\">\u00a0Event Rewards<\/h2>\r\n<h3 class=\"subheading\">\u00a0Rating Rewards<\/h3>\r\n\u00a0You can earn rewards for each new Team Rank you achieve by increasing your team's rating.<br>\r\n\u00a0(Rewards are added directly to your totals.)<br>\r\n\u00a0[Notable Rewards]<br>\r\n\u00a0\u2022 Carats<br>\r\n\u00a0\u2022 Rainbow Crystal Shard<br>\r\n\u00a0\u2022 Gold Crystal Shard<br>\r\n\u00a0\u2022 Trainee Scout Ticket<br>\r\n\u00a0\u2022 Support Card Scout Ticket<br>\r\n<h3 class=\"subheading\">\u00a0Event Missions<\/h3>\r\n\u00a0You can also obtain rewards by completing the event's daily missions and special missions.<br>\r\n\u00a0[Notable Rewards]<br>\r\n\u00a0\u2022 Carats<br>\r\n\u00a0\u2022 Rainbow Crystal Shard<br>\r\n\u00a0\u2022 Gold Crystal Shard<br>\r\n<br>\r\n<h2 class=\"heading\">\u00a0Changes from the Previous Aim for the Stars! Dream Team Event<\/h2>\r\n\u00a01. A new Scout Rankings feature has been added.<br>\r\n\u00a0This feature allows you to view the top 100 Veteran Umamusume that have been scouted most frequently during the event period.<br>\r\n\u00a0These rankings are based on data gathered from all trainers around the world.<br>\r\n\u00a0\u00a0\u00a0\u2022 Scout Rankings are updated daily at 10:00 p.m. (UTC).<br>\r\n\u00a0\u00a0\u00a0\u2022 On the first day of the event, data is still being tallied, so no rankings are available to view.<br>\r\n\u00a0\u00a0\u00a0\u2022 Umamusume featured in the rankings will continue to be displayed even if the original Veteran Umamusume is transferred.<br>\r\n\u00a0\u00a0\u00a0\u2022 If multiple Umamusume are scouted an equal number of times, they will be displayed with the same ranking, and subsequent rankings will be offset accordingly.<br>\r\n\u00a0\u00a0\u00a0\u2022 Only Veteran Umamusume in the Scout Ranking will have their scout totals displayed.<br>\r\n\u00a02. On the Change Captain screen and the confirmation dialog before starting a race, it is now possible to check whether Umamusume have been added to your Records.<br>\r\n\u00a03. On the Change Captain screen and the Scout Time screen, it is now possible to check whether you have acquired Team Skills.<br>\r\n\u00a04. A new Change Captain button has been added to the main event screen.<br>\r\n\u00a05. When choosing an opponent, it is now possible to check how many Scout Points each opponent will yield if defeated.<br>\r\n\u00a06. Umamusume filter options have been adjusted.<br>\r\n\u00a07. In Scout Races, opponent racers' attributes will now be reduced based on the number of times you have retried.<br>\r\n\u00a08. The Team Rank cap has been increased to SS, and rewards for reaching Team Ranks have been adjusted accordingly.<br>\r\n\u00a09. The Record Bonus in Team History has been adjusted.<br>\r\n<h2 class=\"heading\">\u00a0Important Information<\/h2>\r\n\u00a01. For more information on the event, tap the Help icon on the top right of the event screen.<br>\r\n\u00a02. The event schedule and contents are subject to change without notice.<br>\r\n\u00a03. Scout Points earned in this event cannot be carried over to future events.<br>\r\n\u00a04. Team members and Team History will be removed at the end of the event. They cannot be carried over to future events.<br>\r\n\u00a05. If you start a race that ends after the conclusion of the event period, you may not be able to finish.<br>\r\n\u00a06. If Scout Time is active when the event period ends, you may not be able to complete scouting.<br>\r\n\u00a07. If a race is still unfinished when the reward collection period ends, you will not receive rewards.<br>\r\n\u00a08. If a Scout Time session is still unfinished when the reward collection period ends, you will not receive rewards.<br>\r\n\u00a09. If you have unclaimed rewards for an event mission when that mission is reset, they will be sent to your Presents the next time you log in.
